trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document), (p)-[r:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City) WITH DISTINCT p, t, c, CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN '2026/10/14' ELSE p.death_date END AS ref_date WITH p, t, c, CAST(split_part(ref_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS ref_year, CAST(split_part(ref_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS ref_month, CAST(split_part(ref_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS ref_day, CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year, CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month, CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day RETURN p.nationality AS col1, ref_year - birth_year - CASE WHEN ref_month < birth_month OR (ref_month = birth_month AND ref_day < birth_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS col2, c.city_name AS col3, t.team_name AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team
